text.text_excerpt: When we want fresh seafood, Bobby's Seafood is the place we go in the River Ridge / Harahan area. It's more than just a seafood store (one side offers a great seasonal selection of seafood) as there is a kitchen that serves sandwiches and platters. Restaurant may be pushing the envelope. Yes, you can dine in, if sitting on stools at one of the three high top tables qualifies. However, it's not for dreams of white tablecloth service that you go to Bobby's. It's for the fresh seafood, boiled crabs, and great po-boys. The vast majority of their business is on a carryout basis. Every now and then, when I'm in the mood, I don't mind eating a sandwich and spend my lunchtime watching the people ...

My family has been coming here for years. It is a great place to get fresh Louisiana seafood. I would describe it as a fresh seafood market/poboy shop. My only complaint is that they do not stay open late so its tough to get there after work on the weekdays, but its a family run joint so thats par for the course. They have more than just poboys and fried seafood they also have great prepared food like turtle soup, gumbo, and seafood stuffed bell peppers. They also sell the best remoulade sauce that they buy from a local vendor and it comes in a mason jar. Take that and some of their boiled shrimp and I'm good. Bobby's is my go to place when I'm in the mood for some awesome seafood.

Interesting that everyone is reviewing Bobby's as a sammich joint. I've only ever used them as a fishmonger. (Why, yes, I do like saying fishmonger, why do you ask?) My family has ordered everything from pre-boiled shrimp to live crawfish to fresh oysters. The seafood is always first rate. C'mon they have to be good since they're housed in a former gas station.
